phrase: Had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to?
kya aapko us ghatna ke bare mein bure sapne aate hain?
Tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)?
kya aapne us ghatna ko bhulne ki koshish ki hai?
Been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled?
kya aap hamesha dar me rehte hain ya achanak chonk jate hain?
Felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings?
kya aap logon se alag thalag mehsus karte hain?
Felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused?
kya aap khud ko ya dusron ko dosh dete hain us ghatna ke liye?
